title: No repeat death
description: The first time each type of death occurs, a positive buff is granted. On the second death, the buff is reduced or a debuff is applied. Certain items can remove debuffs, enhancing the vanilla survival experience.
body:
##  **Death Enhancement — Vanilla Minecraft Datapack**

This datapack adds strategic depth and fun to Minecraft survival by reworking how death events impact the player. Instead of simply respawning, each death has consequences — and potential benefits — that influence your journey.

---

### **Core Mechanics**

**First Death Bonus**
When a player dies from a new type of death (e.g., fall, fire, lava, mobs, etc.) for the first time, a positive buff is granted.  
This reward gives players an edge, encouraging them to take risks and learn from their experiences.

 **Repeated Death Penalty**
If the player dies again from the *same* death type, the previously earned buff will be removed and may be replaced with a debuff.  
This discourages repetitive mistakes and adds layers of strategic caution to survival gameplay.

---

###  Golden Apple Unlocks

When a player obtains a golden apple, it unlocks **Item Crafting Recipe**, including:

-  **Protective Shield** – Grants temporary extra protection  
-  **Debuff Removal** – Removes one active negative effect

This mechanic turns golden apples into valuable strategic resources, not just food.

---

###  Designed for Vanilla Survival

This datapack:
- Works in **Vanilla Minecraft** (no mods or loaders required)
- Is compatible with both **singleplayer and multiplayer**
- Enhances challenge and strategy without breaking progression

---

###  Summary of Features

- First-time death rewards with unique buffs  
- Second death from the same cause removes buffs and may apply penalties  
- Golden apple unlocks healing utilities (shield and debuff removal)  
- Pure vanilla datapack — no mods needed  
- Made to enrich survival gameplay and decision-making  

**This is my frist Datapack,thanks for you play.**
